lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: So you're the drifter who walked in off the ash. I'm Maren. I won't waste your time.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: The Iron Warden walks the foundry road. Forty years it slept. Now it crushes every caravan that tries for the east.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: No caravans, no food. Cinderwell has a season left, maybe. Will you stop it?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Fifty scrip. Every coin the town has left. And our thanks, for what that's worth.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Then enjoy the quiet while it lasts.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Take these. Ember shards, from the foundry's last pour. Speak the old words and they burn.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Brannick holds the east gate. Tell him I sent you.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: The Warden won't wait forever, and neither will we. Brannick's at the east gate.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Is that... its heart? Still warm. Then it's over.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Cinderwell owes you everything. The road east is open, and so is our door.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Caravans by spring, they say. Because of you.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Gate's shut. Warden's out there. Go home, drifter.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Maren sent you? Gods. Here's the key. The foundry's past the bridge; follow the old road.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Raiders camp along the road too. Watch your back.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Still breathing? Good. Keep it that way.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Welcome to Joss's, the only store in Cinderwell. Which is why the shelves are bare.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Raiders hit my wagon on the Ashen Road and took a crate of machine parts. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Their cache is somewhere along the road east. Try not to get shot.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Any luck with my parts?

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: My parts! Here: Granddad's revolver, and a few rounds for it. It shoots straighter than I do.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Back again? The shelves are almost full, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Have a look.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Another one walking in with ash in their lungs. Sit. Let me show you something useful.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Pressure, clean cloth and a steady hand. That's Mend. It won't regrow a leg, but it'll keep you walking.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Hurt? Ten scrip and I'll patch you right up.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: There. Try to keep your blood on the inside.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: Hey! You look like you can fight. Can you find something for me?

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: I lost Mom's locket in the scrapyard, north of the square. There's... things in there now.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: Really? You're the best!

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: Did you find it yet? It's silver, with a little picture inside.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: That's it! That's Mom's! Here, take these. I, um, borrowed them from Doc.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: When I grow up I'm gonna fight Wardens too.

lines.speaker: villager
lines.text: Ash, ash, ash. Sweep it today, it's back tomorrow. Like the Warden.

lines.speaker: villager2
lines.text: The cistern's low. If the caravans don't come soon, we'll be drinking ash.

choices.text: Let me see what you have.
